info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Status API provides real-time insights into the current status of streaming subscriptions within the platform. By leveraging this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed information on active subscriptions, including their operational state and any alerts associated. This API is essential for developers and administrators looking to monitor subscription performance and ensure a seamless streaming experience for end-users. Typical consumers include service operators and analytics teams who require up-to-date information on subscription health and activity.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of subscriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows the user to fetch the current status of subscriptions. It provides detailed information about active, inactive, or pending subscriptions, enabling effective management and monitoring.
